content: दर्शिन् {%a.%} [दृश्-णिनि] (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Seeing, perceiving, viewing, observing, knowing, understanding, showing, exhibiting; तद्दर्शिनमुदासीनं त्वामेव पुरुषं विदुः <ls>Ku. 2. 13</ls>. .²2 Receiving, securing; नृपतिरिव निकाममायदर्शी <ls>Mk. 2. 7</ls>. .²3 Experiencing; <ls>Rām. 3</ls>.
